high_level_description: The image is a promotional graphic for the Marvel Cinematic Universe, specifically related to the upcoming film "The Fantastic Four." The background is a light beige color, giving it a clean and simple aesthetic. At the top of the image, there is text that reads: "MARVEL CINEMATIC UNIVERSE" in a small, blue font. Below this, in larger, bold blue letters, it states: "MARVEL STILL PLANNING TO HAVE GALACTUS TO BE THE MAIN VILLAIN IN 'THE FANTASTIC FOUR'". This text is attributed to "GEEKSTER | VIA: JEFF SN
